lines.english: "Uhm… Anyway, here's to a day's hard work! Cheers～!"
"…Cheers?"
Takeya is desperate. He's desperate to try and keep everyone in high spirits.
…Almost as if trying to deny the reason the four of us are gathered here in the first place.
"Alright, let's start ordering. I'm in the mood for some Korean Jjigae, what do you guys think?"
"Iizuka-san."
"I see… Then let's just order a large variety of stuff instead. Let's see here, french fries and cold tofu…"
"Takeya."
"Fine, I get it. You want some Dashimaki eggs, right? No matter where we eat you always…"
"Iizuka-san, just shut up already."
"We'll handle things from here. You can just sit there and drink."
Takeya was desperate.
He was desperate to hold back Yanagihara Tomo, who seemed ready for a fight. And Io, who looked like she was dying to say something.
From the moment I showed my face in the meeting spot by the station, to the moment we reached the bar table.
It was Takeya's idea to discuss this in a bar. A bit unlike himself, he's going above and beyond to make things easier… for me alone.
But once our toasts were said, there was no longer any stopping these two.
"Kitahara-san… what did you do to Setsuna?"
"Yanagihara-san…"
"Ah, I'll explain from the start. Thing is, ever since the beginning of the week…"
"No, I keep telling you it's all a misunderstanding, yet Tomo is jumping to all kinds of weird conclusions…"
"Do you have any idea what state Setsuna is in right now? …It's all because of you, you know."
"I do think she's exaggerating a little bit. But it's true that Setsuna isn't answering any of our calls."
"It's probably because of something stupid, right? It shouldn't be anything worth getting so worked up about. Tomo is just being overly nosy as always."
"Hold on a second! Don't interrupt me… Didn't I invite you guys so you could hear what I have to say?"
"But the one who invited Haruki was me."
"And the one who convinced Takeya was me. So we can't let you just throw around accusations unchallenged. Though I'm not going to defend Haruki to the same extent as Takeya."
They all looked like they had many questions to ask me, but it was too disorganized to get anywhere.
But everything from their opinions to their information was completely scattered.
The difference of opinion between Tomo and the other two was like night and day.
"You can't… get in touch with Setsuna?"
"I asked her mother, and it seems she is at least still going to work. So I think she might just be sulking a little bit."
"I keep telling you I saw her! She was crying her eyes out, right in front of his apartment!"
"…She has been like this since the beginning of the week. So we thought we had to talk to you about it, at least."
"I've never seen Setsuna like that before… Even back then, two years ago, she was never like this."
"Setsuna was…?"
This Sunday, she was in front of my apartment…?
That was the day after…
"What did you tell her? …No, there is only one thing that could put her in that state. You broke up with her, didn't you?"
"Like I said, calm down. Why do you always have to go with the first thing that comes to your mind?"
"Well, something could have happened which ultimately led to the topic of breaking up in the heat of the moment, but obviously they wouldn't mean it."
"That's not true! You're only saying that because you haven't seen how bad Setsuna is doing right now."
Tomo uses every fiber of her being denouncing me, yet it still isn't enough.
Or rather, the harder she pushes against me, the more the other two come to my defense.
"Tell me, Kitahara-san… You're together with Touma Kazusa now, aren't you? You've been seeing her in secret, haven't you?"
"Eh…"
"I told you to drop that! I only planned this meeting because you promised not to talk about that…"
"Aah, sorry, Haruki. We obviously don't believe that."
"But, but, but… I saw her! She was in the apartment right next to Kitahara-san's…"
It may be due to the difference in time spent with me, or merely their disposition toward Yanagihara-san's personality…
What's ironic is… the more they come to my defense, the more Takeya and Io stray further from the truth.
And Yanagihara-san, who's acting the most hostile toward me right now, is the only one who knows the ridiculously horrible truth.
"It's just that… I don't think Tomo is completely making things up either."
"Io…"
"We thought that if things have gone this far, perhaps Touma might have something to do with it."
"Take for example, that ever since Touma-san came back to Japan, you've been having a lot of complicated feelings, or something like that…"
"Maybe you went to see one of her concerts without telling Setsuna-chan. Does that ring a bell?"
"You guys…"
"Why won't you believe me…? You were taking everything I told you seriously until yesterday!"
It's not just that they trust me.
"Why do you lose your spines the moment Kitahara-san is around? Aren't you worried about Setsuna?"
"Well, of course we're worried. We're worried, but until Haruki…"
"Let's listen to what Haruki has to say. If he manages to explain everything, then you'd be satisfied too, right, Tomo?"
Takeya and Io "want to" believe me. They're waiting for me to dispel their worries.
They want me to laugh at the idea that I'd break up with Setsuna. They want me to reaffirm that there's nothing between Kazusa and me anymore.
That our friendship would never break apart…
"So, Haruki… be honest with us."
"Io…"
Let's say I were to improvise an answer…
Scratch my head with a half regretful look on my face, and say "Sorry, we got into a little fight."
They would undoubtedly believe me over her.
They'd look at each other and laugh as they say "not again…" and then promise to help us make up.
"There's something we can do to help, right? Don't hold it all in, for Setsuna-chan's sake too."
"Takeya…"
And then everything would be resolved…
Because this friendship is almost rigged to continue existing.
So even now, we can still go back to those old peaceful days with just the four of us… perhaps even the five of us.
I could turn back the clock, and it'd be as if nothing happened…
"…I love Kazusa."
How idiotic…
Of course I can't go back.
I told them everything…
When I was finished telling them everything I told Setsuna, silence enveloped our table.
Because as I went from one matter to another, I was vindicating Yanagihara Tomo little by little.
I told the truth in its terrible entirety. Neither Takeya nor Io tried reinterpreting it to make me look better, even though I'm sure they could.
"Hah, ahaha…"
"Io…"
The bustle of the bar painfully reverberates in my ear. After all, this is the only table this quiet.
Yanagihara Tomo glares at me, and looks at Takeya and Io from the side.
And Io, rather than looking at any one person, stares down at the table as her shoulders shake slightly.
"You're lying…"
And in unison, her voice was also subtly shaking.
"Tell me you're lying, Haruki… Laugh at me and say it was all a bad joke!"
"Io…"
"No! That's not what I want to hear."
My trying to be considerate, in a way almost identical to how Io usually is, was the last thing she wanted to hear.
"I mean… we always knew… that Touma Kazusa was in love with you five years ago, and just as deeply as Setsuna was."
The moment the truth slipped from my mouth, Io stopped doubting her thoughts.
"But it is too late for you to accept those feelings now! She's awful for suggesting it… but you're even more awful for accepting her, Haruki!"
She finally understood that I'm not lying… That the true lie had been everything I had told her up until today.
"How many years have you and Setsuna been together…? How many times do you have to betray her…? How many times do you have to hurt her until you're satisfied…?"
That realization was visible when she raised her head.
"How many years have you been separated from Touma Kazusa…? So why does it have to be her? How much do you have to obsess over her until you're finished?"
She grits her teeth, pulls away her face, and her eyes start watering as if on the verge of crying. But in her misery, she can't even bring herself to cry.
"She's the woman who ruined your relationship with Setsuna and ran away immediately after. She already abandoned you once, Haruki!"
Both anger and sadness, disappointment and confusion. All these emotions blended together…
"I don't get it… I don't get what's going on inside your head at all, Haruki!"
"…I'm sorry."
"Don't say 'I'm sorry'! What you're supposed to do right now isn't to apologize! Why can't you understand that!?"
But at the same time, it was an expression she was showing me because we were friends.
Io hadn't given up yet. She was desperately trying to get me back on her side.
That Setsuna needs me, and that the best possible resolution is for me to be with Setsuna. This would be for Setsuna's sake, but also mine.
However…
"What are you going to do about Setsuna…? Are you going to just abandon her after ruining her like that?"
"Yanagihara…"
But Yanagihara-san was on Setsuna's side more than anyone else.
"The two of you were engaged until now. Why would you go out of your way to make her feel like she's in heaven just to put her through hell? What did she do to deserve that…?"
"No… Setsuna hasn't… done anything…"
"Do you hate her that much? Going out of your way to make sure she suffers in the worst way possible… Do you think she killed your parents or something?"
"You're wrong… stop this, please."
That's why she's brazenly throwing all the questions at me that neither Takeya nor Io have ever dared to ask me.
The most important question they just had to make sure of, and the question that I want to answer the least…
"All this time, Setsuna has chosen a lifestyle that would go in line with yours, Kitahara-san. She limited her own opportunities for your sake!"
What Yanagihara Tomo wanted out of Setsuna was different from me.
"Her education… her job… even her singing…"
Yes, even her singing.
She understood Setsuna's songs better than anyone else, was a bigger fan than anyone else, and was her biggest promoter.
She desired the artist SETSUNA more than the actual Ogiso Setsuna.
"She made it a condition… that she could still be with you, that she could still have the time to see you…!"
But Setsuna graduated, found herself a job, and her appearances on stage grew fewer and fewer.
Because I wasn't on the stage with her. Because I wouldn't go to see her concerts. Because it would take time away from being with me.
Her own strength and potential, and the reality that stood in its way. And then all the other reasons…
But no one would believe me if I told them I had nothing to do with them or her decision.
"Because, she intended to be with you forever. She intended to spend her entire life with you!"
Despite that, she thought about Setsuna's feelings and respected the path she chose.
All while looking at me in contempt, yet she still looked at the two of us when we were together with a bitter smile.
"So why Touma Kazusa after all this time? Why can't you be happy with Setsuna…?"
But just now, she was hit with the horrifying reality that Setsuna's sacrifice was completely pointless…
"Was she that good in bed? Did she find all your weak spots?"
I understand her anger completely.
But I cannot do anything to quell it. I have no choice but to accept it all.
"Losing your sense just because some woman you used to know spread her legs for you… Did it feel that good?"
"Don't… say that! Blame me all you want, but leave Kazusa out of it…"
"Did she perhaps know some amazing techniques? I bet she played you the same way she plays that piano of hers… just like her mother used to."
"Stop it, stop it…! I haven't slept with Kazusa! She's not that kind of woman!"
…But I couldn't accept her going after Kazusa.
"She's been through a lot too! She's been lost, and suffering… so please don't talk like that about her!"
The only things I want to protect are Kazusa's feelings, and her honor.
Because I promised to protect her. The only one facing judgement was to be me.
"…Really? You're the worst."
But the retort, and my judgement came from a direction I didn't expect…
"You haven't even slept with her. You haven't even done anything. It's not like you're burdened with something you can't take back…"
"You're just going to abandon Setsuna simply because you love her…?"
I insisted… insisted on the last bastion that is protecting Kazusa.
"Then, what does Setsuna mean to you? Are you saying that even after joining with her in both body and mind, your bond with her is still no match for what you have with Touma-san?"
"…What are you…?"
But that attempt only had the opposite effect on her.
Io is… completely and utterly disgusted with me.
"What does Setsuna mean to you? Do you think that any of those things you said gives you an excuse? How much are you looking down on Setsuna, Haruki?"
"Eh, no, that's not… I didn't… w-wait…"
All the color drains from her face, her feelings evaporate, and the anger she directed at me earlier is nowhere to be seen.
"You've ruined everything for those around you, and now you're saying it's all platonic between you two…?"
"What a poor excuse for love. I feel like vomiting."
"Wait a second!"
I was prepared to lose my friends today.
I thought that it was only natural for them to hate me, to look at me with nothing but contempt.
Yet the words Io threw at me hurt far more than I ever imagined.
"Fine then… The two of you can go ahead and live in your little fantasy world and play house together."
"Y-You… have it wrong… Listen to me, Io."
I never imagined I'd be met with disgust about that one thing… and to have my reasoning be so utterly rejected.
"It doesn't matter how much you two hurt everyone around you. After all, your bond is so strong you can't see beyond each other, so it's fine."
"Kazusa has… been through a lot. Even with how famous she is, she's still all by herself… so I'm… I'm the only one she has."
All the things I desperately planned to hold in until everything came to an end…
"So it's alright since Setsuna hasn't been through a lot? It's okay for you to abandon her because she's not all by herself?"
"I never said that!"
All of the harsh constraints that I put on myself in order to not hurt Setsuna more than I already have…
"That's exactly what you're saying, Haruki… If you disappear, Setsuna won't be all alone. You won't feel sorry for her so it's okay to abandon her. That's what you're saying…"
All of that didn't just become utterly meaninglessーit ended up degrading Setsuna even more…
"That's… not…"
Yet again, I wasn't prepared for this whatsoever.
I kept telling myself that I was going to make enemies of everyone, that I was going to lose all my friends, yet…
"Io, I am… I am…"
"It hurts, doesn't it, Haruki?"
It hurts.
It hurts that my feelings aren't being conveyed. It hurts that my love for her isn't reaching them.
"But you know, Haruki… this is what Setsuna looks like after being abandoned by you…"
Yes, it is…
This is the desperate pain Setsuna was bottling up back then.
This is my retribution for switching partners overnight.
Something I must accept, Io's very last…
"…The two of you, go home."
However, the moment I thought my heart was going to break in two, a calm yet overpowering voice interrupts me.
"If you have no intention of convincing Haruki, then go home. If all you're going to do is to talk down to him, then leave and never see him again."
"Iizuka-san…?"
After being told to shut up by the women, Takeya had been keeping to himself.
"Give up already. Actually, it seems you've already given up. Then you're of no use here."
"W…What did you say?"
Takeya, who had been wordlessly gazing at me from the side, suddenly takes control of the whole conversation.
"I haven't given up. I'll convince Haruki… I'll make him reconsider his feelings about Setsuna, no matter what."
Of all things, he willingly stands against the women's sense of justice.
"There's no need for people like you two around if you're only going to drive Haruki against the wall. So get out of here already."
"Takeya… stop it."
He's… going against Io.
He's going against the person who was closer to him than anyone else, the person who he watched over Setsuna and me with.
"What is… this? Takeya… are you defending Haruki? Are you telling me I'm wrong?"
"I don't give a damn about that. All I know is that you're currently in the way of me talking to Haruki."
"…! Hey! Whose side are you on… mine or Haruki's!?"
"I thought that would be obvious…"
"Cut it out already!"
No matter how I look at it, Takeya has no reason at all to defend me.
And no matter how I look at it, the ones who are saying the right things here are Io and Yanagihara.
And yet, I know the name Takeya's going to say.
"I'm on Haruki's side."
Yet I couldn't stop it from boiling over…
"Take this, it'll sober you up a bit."
"…Thank you."
After that, the two women left. …With harsh, condemning looks in their eyes that were focused on Takeya more than me.
But once our table became quiet, neither of us were in the mood for conversation. Before long, the two of us had left the bar too.
Takeya walked along the city streets in silence, and I followed behind him without saying a word.
"Well, that was some nasty business."
"Yeah…"
Under the cold night sky, we finally find a place to sit and share our canned coffees.
The warmth from the coffee permeates throughout my entire body, although I didn't need it to sober up since I had barely drunk anything.
"Sorry about that whole mess."
"I was the one who caused it."
"…Well, I suppose you're right."
Ever since he chased out the girls, or perhaps ever since we met up, Takeya had been very relaxed.
Among the four of us, he was careful not to stir anything up; instead, he stuck to the backseat role and threw in a laugh or two when he could.
"Make sure to make up with Io later, okay? I won't be able to smooth things out between you two any longer."
"You're worried about us at this stage? Have you forgotten about the mess you're in?"
Well, as expected, not even he could hide his frustration this far in.
"Aa-ah, why do I have to pick up the pieces after that mess?"
"Pick up the pieces…?"
"Irrespective of whether you're right or wrong, I out of all people should know… that you never budge once you've made up your mind."
"Takeya…"
"Seriously, why do things have to be like this…?"
No, perhaps it was his plan to lose his cool halfway through from the start, to settle the score alone with me.
So he can take on all the responsibility by himself when he fails to convince me.
It's almost as though he's ready to take on the responsibility for all my actions…
The winter cold pierces through me much harsher than usual, perhaps because I didn't drink all that much.
The canned coffee I had in my hand had turned cold before I knew it, and was no longer suitable to warm my hands.
"…Takeya."
"Hm?"
I'm not sure if I'm feeling cold because of the loneliness that's welling up within me, or if it's because of another reason.
"Could you listen to what I have to say?"
The only thing I wanted to do was to convey something to the only person standing in front of me.
I wanted to tell him a single truth, with just a few excuses put in.
"Houjou University Hospital… That's pretty under wraps. The mass media doesn't know a thing, huh?"
"It seems a lot of politicians and artists are being taken care of there. They're probably used to that kind of care."
When Takeya heard about Touma Youko's illness and the place she was staying at, he was at a loss for words.
It's only natural for him to react that way, I suppose. In fact, he's taking this much better than expected.
Perhaps it's because Youko-san is nothing but a stranger to him, or perhaps because he figured something out from my behavior.
"I'd prefer if you didn't say a word of this to anyone, of course. It could make a lot of noise here in Japan."
"Not even to Setsuna-chan?"
"…Especially not Setsuna."
"Why not? It's one of your reasons for leaving, isn't it?"
"That's just an excuse. And it doesn't change the fact that I'm making the wrong choice."
"Yeah, you're right. You made the wrong choice… you should have talked about this honestly to Setsuna-chan."
The wrong choice Takeya was referring to was a bit different from what I was thinking of.
"Had you spoken to her about it honestly, Setsuna-chan could have carried the burden with you."
"…Probably. It's Setsuna, after all."
But we both know that the central point of the issue is different between us.
"Had you done that… then perhaps, you would have been able to find a better solution…"
And then I start to understand. Takeya is drifting away from the point on purpose.
"Is there… no such choice? Is it not still possible for the three of you to talk it out together?"
For us to share our wisdom together, carry each other's burdens, and perhaps find a better solution to all this.
"Sharing the pain amongst the three of us," something I'd usually suggest.
"That's no longer possible…"
"Why?"
But that choice is…
"I've already decided to live with Kazusa from now on. And I swore to not involve Setsuna in it."
"There might be greater happiness if you do involve her! I'm certain Setsuna-chan herself would agree!"
"Even then… I can't anymore."
"Then tell me why!"
"…If we shared the burden among the three of us, then… I might be unable to pick Kazusa anymore."
I could only make that kind of choice once I was determined to give up on Kazusa.
"I really loved Kazusa all along. I wanted to make her mine alone."
But if Kazusa's burden is shared among the three of us and the three of us become happy because of that…
"I thought I was over her two years ago, but I was wrong. Even after all this time, nothing has changed. I only piled up lie over lie for these two years until I started believing them myself."
Then Kazusa will stop trying to make me hers. She'll disappear by herself before I know it.
"That's why I can't rely on Setsuna… It's all just because of my ego."
It will be a future without Kazusa by my side.
Three will find happiness, two will find happiness in each other… while two will be left without the happiness they want.
"You're despicable, you know that? …And Touma is just as bad."
"Kazusa has nothing to do with it. It's all my…"
"No matter how much you try to defend her, and no matter what her circumstances may be, nothing changes the fact that she has done something terrible."
"She's trying to make a man her own… even if it means breaking up a relationship between two people who truly love each other, and are even engaged."
"Out of all the women I've met, I have never encountered such a terrible woman. I wouldn't get within ten feet of her."
"Ah, aah…"
I had nothing to counter him with.
"Stop it, stop it…!"
Because emotions are filling my mind rather than reason.
"Don't say bad things about Kazusa… not my Kazusa."
Nothing but those laughable responses came to mind.
"I misjudged you. I always thought you were a man of good judgement… At the very least, I thought you had better judgement than me."
Takeya sees that I have nothing to respond with, so he breathes a sigh as if he's had enough.
Just a few moments before, he had shut down Io and Yanagihara-san and proclaimed himself as my ally…
"I don't even want to talk to you right now. That's how much of a poor opinion I have of you."
"…I'm sorry."
But in time, even Takeya leaves my side…
"But I'm still your friend. I may not have any desire to be, but even then, I'm still your friend…"
"Takeya…?"
"So this is my last request… I'm begging you, Haruki… go back to your usual self!"
"Eh?"
"If you only say the word, if you say you're going back to Setsuna-chan, then I'll make sure everything goes back to normal!"
"Hey…"
"I'll convince Io, Tomo, and everyone else too! I'll make sure every single thing you said today is forgotten, so please… please…"
Ah, this guy…
"I'm begging you… I'm begging you… take it all back! All you have to do is to say it was a bad joke and apologize."
…Really was a true friend of mine…
The only one I had… and I'll probably never be able to see him again…
He was another person I considered most important to me, in a different way than both Setsuna and Kazusa.
"Takeya… I…"
"I can't do that."
"…! Uu-gh, aah…!"
…He was someone that was truly precious to me.
"I knew I was wrong from the very beginning. Even so, it's not like I wanted to set things right from the beginning either."
"Why, why though…? I can't believe it… Why, Haruki…!?"
Damn it, I'm such an idiot. …I only realize how precious our friendship is when I'm about to lose it.
"I've… always been like this. I'm stupid down to my very core."
All of this is really so stupid. Everything I've done up until now could only be described that way…
"I try to do the right thing, but I get it wrong. And even when I know what the right thing is, I still do the wrong thing."
New discoveries, happiness, frustration, pain, and nostalgia that I once shared with him are brought to my mind.
"But… this is just too big of a mistake… Not even I could mess up that badly. How could you… abandon such a good girl like Setsuna-chan…?"
In this hopeless situation, the expression he desperately tried to keep to prevent himself from crying slackened for just a moment.
"Take it back… if not, then this time, I'll truly have no choice but to disdain you…"
"I know that."
"I won't be able to defend you… I won't want to defend you. I'll be forced to admit that you're an awful person…"
"Don't defend me anymore. You'll end up losing your friends too, you know?"
"Haruki…! You, you… can't be serious!"
Thank you, Takeya…
"It's not true… It can't be true!"
But please don't cry anymore.
Because I don't have the right to cry. I don't have the right to be sad.
All this is due to my own actions. There is not a single thing that couldn't have been prevented.
I willingly chose this avoidable fate out of my own desire alone.
"You can go already. Nothing will change from talking any further."
"Wait… wait a minute…!"
I'm really, really… grateful to you, Takeya.
Thanks to you, I found a tiny bit of salvation…
"If you're not going, then I'll go ahead. Bye, then."
"I'll never forgive you… I won't forgive you for the rest of my life, Haruki…"
It's already been destroyed, though…
Even so, up until a few moments ago, there was true friendship between us…
"Goodbye… Takeya."
"God damn it…!"
I can go on believing that.
It seems like the trains are still operating.
In this station that never sleeps even in the middle of a snowy night, the ticket gates continue to spew forth countless people.

Perhaps I felt relieved by seeing the big crowd of people in front of the station, or perhaps I felt overwhelmed by all the things that had happened up until now, and before I knew it, I was looking up at the sky.
The bright lights of the city make most of the stars invisible, with only the bright moon watching over the city.
It felt like I was dreaming. Of course, it was not a good dream.
He was the first friend I ever made after I enrolled in high school. He was always at the center of all my relationship problems.
I thought that our friendship would stick around whether I wanted it or not.
I worried about their future.
Those two have been stuck together for longer than Takeya and me. Yet they're never honest with each other, so I'd get irritated at how nothing ever progressed between them.
I thought to myself that one day I would be able to do something for them, the same way they helped me out.
Yet all the strings that brought us three together have been cut loose.
All because of my own mistakes, and my mistakes alone.
"Ah…"
Even so, with the way things have turned out, I don't even have the time to lament over it.
I can't even cry over Yanagihara-san hating me, Io being fed up with me, and losing my best friend… Takeya.
Tell me God, was what I did truly so awful…?
"Hello… this is Kitahara."
"It's Ogiso… Setsuna's father."
"…Good evening."
Yes… of course it was.
